title: Operation lifting from an underlying constant trivialization
statement: Let Y be a scheme, Λ a finite ring, F a sheaf of left Λ-modules, G the underlying sheaf of sets with hG identifying it with the underlying sheaf of F, and 𝒰 an etale cover on which G is constant. Then F is locally constant as a sheaf of Λ-modules.

source.place: Tag 0DV5 proof of (2)--(3), expanded with Tag 093S (1)

proof.text: Refine the given trivialization successively for addition, zero, negation and scalar multiplication over the finite ring; evaluate the module identities on geometric points and package the resulting constant module sheaves.

theorem module_operationCompatibleCover
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [Ring Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hG : G = (sheafForget Y.smallEtaleTopology).obj F)
    (𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage Y)
    (h𝒰 : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      (G.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)).IsConstant
        (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))) :
    IsLocallyConstantSheaf F
